name: Joppa Hill Educational Farm Summer Camp (Farm and Forest Camp)
description_short: An all-outdoor farm day camp for ages 5–12 in Bedford, NH. Each week has its own theme, and campers do daily farm chores and animal care, gardening, and time in the woods, 9 AM–3 PM.
activities: Felting, weaving and dyeing (Animal Arts week)
refund_policy_summary: Cancel more than 6 weeks before the camp week: 95% refund. Cancel 3–6 weeks before: 50% refund. Cancel within 2 weeks: no refund. No refund if a camper is removed for not meeting the independence expectations. Card and ACH processing fees apply.
special_needs_notes: The program is entirely outdoors, with hiking on uneven trails and time outside in all weather. The camp says it "cannot change activities or make significant adjustments for individual campers." Campers must handle basic self-care on their own (port-a-potty, sunscreen, changing clothes). Families who can't meet these expectations should contact the camp first. The site has an Accessibility page.
swim_waterfront_notes: Afternoon Club Time includes "Water Play," and campers change into water play clothes. The page says nothing about swimming. Wetlands, streams and ponds are explored during Wonderful Wetlands week.
